name: DCA Cappuccino Cart (San Fransokyo) Morning Chorizo-Free Egg, Potato & Cheese Breakfast Burrito Mod
brandOrRestaurant: Cappuccino Cart (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Popular rope-drop burrito filled with scrambled eggs, potatoes, and cheese, though the pre-mixed pork chorizo sausage adds paprika/chili fat that makes Pym Test Kitchen's Calculated Breakfast a safer flare choice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering in steady remission, skip the spicy green tomatillo salsa cup; on sensitive days, walk 2 minutes to Pym Test Kitchen for plain Scrambled Eggs, Bacon & Focaccia Toast instead.
watchOuts: Contains spiced chorizo sausage—choose Pym Test Kitchen or Shawarma Palace (no harissa) for a gentler DCA breakfast
